question: Should the entity registry give Logtail (logtail.com) as an alias of Better Stack, and group Hotjar (hotjar.com) and Heap (heap.io), whose sign-up pages sit on Contentsquare hosts, under one Contentsquare vendor entity?
why: The free-for.dev Log Management section lists Logtail as a separate vendor although dev-services/better-stack holds its log offer; Hotjar and Heap share an owner but resolve to separate entities by domain.
